title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
message_html: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading ...
snippet: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.

title: Ant International, DBS, Franklin Templeton automate tokenized deposit to MMF switching
message_html: Ant International, DBS, Franklin Templeton automate tokenized deposit to MMF switching ...
snippet: Ant International has launched its Whale Orchestration Protocol to automatically switch between tokenized deposits and tokenized money market funds (tMMFs), in a collaboration with DBS Bank and Franklin Templeton under Singapore’s Project BLOOM.
